bio: Here the speciality is chargrilled vegetables and seafood. Guests gather around the hearth and charcoal brazier to enjoy the rising aroma of the seafood and vegetables while savouring sake. Among the favourites are the large clams and dried, salted ichiyaboshi fish. Seasonal delicacies like bamboo shoots and mushrooms are also available. The proprietress expertly handles the grilling duties, carefully tending to the charcoal fire. ‘Yamato’ is the name of her family's river fish shop, serving as the inspiration for the owner's charcoal cooking....
